title: Changing groups at a language school
instructionsHu: Egy angliai nyári nyelviskolában tanulsz, de a csoportod túl könnyű neked. Menj be az irodába, magyarázd el a problémát, és intézd el a csoportváltást. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are attending a three-week summer English course in Brighton. After the first two days, you feel that your group is too easy for you: the lessons are boring and you already know most of the grammar. You go to the school office to talk to the course coordinator.
situation.candidateRole: You are a student on the summer course.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the course coordinator at the school office.
goals: Explain why you are not happy with your group.
Ask if you can move to a higher-level group.
Ask about the timetable of the new group.
Find out about the afternoon activities and choose one.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, come in. How can I help you?

followUpQuestions: I see. Can you give me an example of what you're doing in class?
There's a place in the upper-intermediate group, but their lessons start at half past eight. Is that OK for you?
Is there anything else you'd like to know?

usefulPhrases.en: I'm in group B at the moment.
The lessons are too easy for me.
We're revising things I already know.
usefulPhrases.hu: Olyan dolgokat ismétlünk, amiket már tudok.

usefulPhrases.en: Would it be possible to change groups?
What time do the lessons start?
I'd like to sign up for ...
What activities are there in the afternoon?
